_meta.title: GCF Integrated Results Management Framework — core indicators
_meta.note: Only the core indicators this model reports against. Direct and indirect beneficiaries are SEPARATE indicators and are never summed into one figure.

coreIndicators.name: Tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent reduced or avoided
coreIndicators.note: Reduced OR avoided — which one depends entirely on the baseline, so every figure carries its counterfactual.

coreIndicators.name: Direct beneficiaries
coreIndicators.note: Never added to indirect beneficiaries. They measure different things.

supplementary.name: Hectares under improved low-emission or climate-resilient management
Value of physical assets made more resilient or better protected

evidenceTiers.label: Measured
evidenceTiers.note: Metered, surveyed or audited. Traceable to a record held here.

evidenceTiers.label: Modelled
evidenceTiers.note: Computed from project parameters and a named method.

evidenceTiers.label: Benchmark
evidenceTiers.note: A published sector or national default stands in for a project value.

evidenceTiers.label: Declared
evidenceTiers.note: Stated by the sponsor or the insured; not independently verified here.

tierNote: Deliberately NOT PCAF's 1-5 data-quality scale. That scale is defined for financed-emissions inventory and reusing it for project appraisal would misrepresent both.
